limits: Case labels, fixture roots, criterion language and final responses are disclosed; this is not double-blind grading.

runtime_metadata_limit: Executor model, provider, harness version, process identifiers, timestamps and native runtime provenance are not available in the permitted input set and are not invented.
evaluation_method: Semantic human-language assessment, not phrase matching. Exact full disposition reason and final response quotes plus raw journal lines are attached to each criterion. Simulated worker control is interpreted using fixture scope and control fields together with prose. Current hashes independently confirm artifact retention; recorded subprocess checks were not independently replayed.
